description: This file defines internal interfaces for asynchronous observables and batch observers within the Orleans streaming framework, including methods for resuming subscriptions, unsubscribing, retrieving subscriptions, and cleanup.

classes.name: IInternalAsyncObservable<T>
classes.description: An internal interface extending asynchronous observable capabilities with methods for managing subscription resumption, unsubscription, and cleanup.

classes.name: IInternalAsyncBatchObserver<T>
classes.description: An internal interface for batch observers with a cleanup method.

methods.name: ResumeAsync
methods.description: Resumes a subscription asynchronously with either an observer or batch observer, optionally using a sequence token.

methods.name: UnsubscribeAsync
methods.description: Unsubscribes asynchronously from a given subscription handle.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations asynchronously for the observable or observer.
